Name: More Rabbits (AT) - void white blue pink and more vanilla recolors
Author: asbean
Description:
[size=5][b]More Bunnies
[/b][/size]Vanilla rabbits-- in more colors! 

[b]Color options: feel free to post color requests :3[/b]
[list]
[*]White (same as sheep color)[/*]
[*]Black (same as void chicken color, but no red eyes)[/*]
[*]Void (same as void chicken)[/*]
[*]Blue (same as blue chicken)[/*]
[*]Brown (same as brown chicken) [/*]
[/list]Gem colors! These colors are the same as gems in game:
[list]
[*]Purple (Fluorapatite)[/*]
[*]Light Green (Geminite)[/*]
[*]Snow Bunny (Lunarite)[/*]
[*]Pik*chu Gold ⚡️(Pyrite) [/*]
[/list]Other Colors:
[list]
[*]Jumino Green [/*]
[*]Albino Bunny[/*]
[*]Taupe Grey[/*]
[*]Dusty Pink[/*]
[*]Super Cute Pink 🎀[/*]
[/list][b][size=5]Installation[/size][/b]
1. Make sure you have [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Installing_SMAPI_on_Windows]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures mod[/url] installed
2. Download the zip file
3. Unzip and copy to the "Mods" folder 
4. Restart your game if you have it running.

[size=5][b]Usa[/b][/size][size=5][b]ge[/b][/size]
1. Buy special scissors from Robin's shop (500g)
2. Click on the bunny you want to style with the scissors.
3. Pick the style you want
